name: Partnerimmo
positioning: Full-web French software for property administrators, sold as two modules: rental management and condominium management, sharing one accounting core.
description: Partnerimmo is a hosted French application for property administrators, condominium managers and letting agents, in business since 2006. The rental module covers lots, rent calls, receipts, dunning, automated accounting and accounting-entry export, plus digital condition reports with embedded signature. The condominium module covers budgets, calls for funds, bank reconciliation, general meetings with votes and minutes, works and incident tracking. Both expose an extranet to landlords, tenants, co-owners and the condominium council. The editor states 195,000 tenants and 395,000 co-owners are managed on it in 2026, and publishes a starting price.
real_estate_use: A French cabinet d'administration de biens runs two regulated books at once — the landlord's account in gérance and the co-ownership's account in syndic — and both are audited. Partnerimmo is the system of record for that work: it produces the quarterly rent call and the owner statement on one side, the budget, the calls for funds and the general meeting file on the other, and exports entries to the accountant rather than pretending to replace them. The extranet is what removes the phone calls: a co-owner checks their balance and the meeting minutes themselves. The editor migrates the incumbent database as part of onboarding, which is the real decision point — a cabinet changes gérance software once a decade because the accounting history has to survive the move.
features: Rent calls, receipts, dunning and automated rental accounting with entry export
Condominium budgets, calls for funds and bank reconciliation
General meetings: convening, votes and minutes
Digital condition reports with embedded signature, usable on site
Extranet for landlords, tenants, co-owners and the condominium council
Works and incident tracking with quotes

use_cases.job: Run a building's financial year end to end — budget, calls for funds, general meeting, minutes — without leaving one file
Issue the quarterly rent call and owner statement for a managed portfolio and hand clean entries to the accountant
